children: Australian shares were expected to tick down at open on Friday, weighed by possible losses in heavyweight miners as copper prices lost their sheen, while potential gains in energy stocks could temper some weakness on higher oil prices.
The local share price index futures (YAPcm1) fell 0.3%, a 7-point discount to the underlying S&P/ASX 200 index
close. The benchmark lost 0.7% on Thursday.
